persona.label: Adult child caring for an elderly parent
persona.role: SIZE-TIER persona (10k / 40k only) — double-checking, possessive 'mum's / dad's'
speech_habits: possessive framing of every subject: 'mum's review', 'dad's eye clinic'
double-checking and reassurance-seeking: 'can you make sure', 'just so i don't forget'
medical and benefits admin vocabulary carried as titles
long requests with the WHY in front: 'because the carer changes, put ...'
persona.action_bias: appointment-heavy calendar plus a medication and paperwork task list
persona.leak_note: Every person, clinic and service is invented for the size tiers; none was taken from any real person or transcript — and the leak gate runs on every tier build (see PERSONAS.md § Size tiers for what it currently reads).

event_titles: the solicitor about the power of attorney
the phone appointment with the surgery
task_titles: change the bed linen at mum's
check the smoke alarm at dad's
occasions: the move to the ground floor flat

ce_datetime: can you make sure {event_title} is in for {date} at {time}
put {event_title} in {date} at {time}, just so i don't forget
ce_recurring: {event_title} is {recurrence} at {time} now, put it in
ct_bare: just so i don't forget, i need to {task_title}
ct_buy: i need to get {qty} {item} for mum
q_schedule: what have we got on {query_range}, i've lost track
de_named: {event_title} {date} has been cancelled, take it out
dt_named: take {task_title} off the list, the carers are doing it
ue_move: {event_title} has moved to {time}, can you change it
npdecoy_attendees: {event_title} with {name} and {name2} at {time}, add it please
leadtime: {event_title} {date} at {time}, and remind me {lead_time} so we're not late
polite_request: would you be able to add {event_title} {date} at {time}
quoted_delete: can you take '{quoted_item}' out of the calendar
ramble_ce: {filler} because the carer changes, put {event_title} in {date} at {time} {filler2}
and_et: add {event_title} {date} at {time} and remind me to {task_title2}
joiner_then_et: put {event_title} in at {time}, then remind me to {task_title2}
three_ask: add {event_title} at {time} and {event_title2} at {time2} and remind me to {task_title3}
